FAQ

What is Check Point Cloud Firewall, and what security challenges does it solve?

Cloud Firewall is Check Point’s comprehensive cloud security platform designed to protect assets across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments. It addresses key challenges such as misconfigurations, compliance gaps, identity-based risks, and advanced threats targeting cloud workloads and applications.

How does Check Point Cloud Firewall protect multi-cloud environments?

Check Point’s Cloud Firewall provides unified security across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and other platforms. It delivers posture management, threat prevention, and automated compliance enforcement, ensuring consistent protection and visibility across all cloud environments.

Can Check Point Cloud Firewall secure both workloads and applications?

Yes. Check Point’s Cloud Firewall secures cloud workloads, applications, and APIs with advanced threat prevention, runtime protection, and vulnerability management. It also includes Web Application Firewall (WAF) capabilities to safeguard against OWASP Top 10 risks.

Does Check Point Cloud Firewall integrate with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines?

Absolutely. Check Point Cloud Firewall integrates seamlessly with DevOps tools and CI/CD workflows, enabling security-as-code. It automates security checks during development and deployment, ensuring compliance and reducing risk without slowing down innovation.

How is Check Point Cloud Firewall different from other cloud security solutions?

Check Point Cloud Firewall stands out by offering a unified platform for posture management, workload protection, and application security, combined with Check Point’s industry-leading threat intelligence. It provides deep visibility, automated remediation, and scalability across multi-cloud environments—all managed from a single console.
